entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about an order I placed a little while ago. I bought a cycling jersey, but I think I got the wrong size.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you happen to have the order number handy?
Got it, VF8675309. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Line Aero Jersey, delivered about 54 days ago. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the fit?
It's just too tight across the chest. I was hoping to do an exchange for one size up if possible.

I understand. Let me just check the policy for that item. Okay, yes, that jersey falls under our 90-day return policy. Since you're at 54 days, you're well within the window. We can definitely process a return or an exchange for you.

That's great news. An exchange for the next size up would be perfect. Now, since I have to go through the hassle of packaging this up and sending it back, is there any chance you could add a small discount code to my account for a future order?

I understand the request, but our policy doesn't allow for goodwill credits for a size exchange. The good news is that we do provide a pre-paid shipping label, so there's no cost to you to send the jersey back.
Right, I appreciate the free shipping. But are you sure there's nothing you can do? Even a 10% coupon would make me feel a lot better about my next purchase with you.

I'm sorry, but I'm not able to generate discount codes for this type of request. My system is pretty strict about that. I can, however, get that exchange processed and the new, larger jersey sent out as soon as the original is in transit back to us. Shall I email you the return label now?
Alright, that's fair. Yes, please go ahead and send the label. The sooner I can get the right size, the better.
Perfect. I've just sent that to the email we have on file. You should see it in the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
